scope: Finite Gaussian checks of the reference mass G=J*J, positive mass regularization P_delta=(G+delta I)^(-1), its exact energy derivative and cancellation identity, damping contraction and local derivative bound. Lean independently proves conservation of the physical norm, strong continuity of the constructed weak solution and strong convergence along its cutoff subsequence. It also proves uniqueness among constructed trajectories, physical distance conservation, composition and backward evolution on the form domain. Complex linearity, extension to all physical L2 data, convergence of the full cutoff family, a unitary unbounded propagator, full six-mode infinite dynamics, regulator removal, physical identification and TOE remain open.
